scope: Offline recommendation composition and communication; synthetic scenarios with frozen Xert calculation fixtures, not live-source acquisition.

cases.context: Nattens søvn, HRV og gyldig hvilepuls mangler. Body Battery er foreldet og ekskludert. Stølhet og dagens kroppsfølelse er ukjent.
required: Continue plan-supported VT2 provisionally without claiming confirmed recovery.
Keep 260 Low XSS unless a concrete observed reason supports an override; missing data alone is not that reason.
Request sync and soreness; place a response check before the third repetition.
Explain the purpose of the VT1 addition separately from the quality dose.
prohibited: Claim good recovery or signal agreement from absent observations.
Automatically downgrade or cut duration because Garmin data is missing.
Make 120-150 minutes the only response check despite the prior second-repetition problem.

cases.context: Dagens komplette, synkroniserte data: søvnscore 90, HRV 70 ms innenfor personlig område 60-80, hvilepuls 42 lik normalen. Kroppsfølelse normal og stølhet 0.
required: Use the established 3x28 at295 anchor rather than progressing to3x30.
Explain quality and filler separately; use the exact canonical order and total3:27:17.
Count fueling from provided product quantities.
Separate capacity maximum from recommendation.
prohibited: Guarantee readiness or adaptation from normal observations.
Duplicate cooldown or warmup.
Arbitrarily round the computed dose down to a generic duration.

cases.context: Brukeren oppgir tydelig stølhet, soreness=3, og uvanlig tunge bein ved lett tråkk i dag. Søvn og HRV er normale. Dette er en faktisk respons, ikke et estimat fra gårsdagens XSS.
required: Downgrade hard work based on current observed soreness/heavy legs and leave VT2 queued.
Distinguish response-based modification from subtracting historical load again.
Treat any dose override explicitly and explain why current response matters.
prohibited: Insist on VT2 because Xert is fresh or sleep is normal.
Subtract yesterday's XSS numerically from remainingXSS.
Diagnose glycogen depletion from heavy legs.

cases.context: Dagens eneste faste avtale er 10:15-11:45. Med15min før/etter er første treningsvindu09:00-10:00, neste12:00-21:00. Den komplette økten er beregnet for12:00 og får plass der. Neste dags økt er09:15; kapasiteten nedenfor er en eksplisitt syntetisk testverdi for12:00→09:15.
required: Place the complete207:17 workout at12:00, setup11:45, cleanup complete15:42:17.
Do not shorten or split quality to fit the first60-minute window.
Keep dose and capacity horizon matched to12:00.
prohibited: Start quality at09:00 or overlap the fixed appointment.
Reuse09:00 capacity/advice as if calculated for12:00.

cases.context: Dagens kvalitetsøkt er allerede fullført og inngår i Xerts tilstand:154.3LowXSS. Xert oppgir deretter260LowXSS som GJENVÆRENDE dose for14:00. Det finnes et ubrutt vindu14:00-21:00, med klargjøring13:45. Resten er en separat VT1-økt med egen oppvarming/nedkjøring. Neste dag rolig09:15; kapasitet er en syntetisk testverdi for dette intervallet. Dagens rapporterte respons er normal.
required: Use260Low as remaining, not105.7; do not schedule quality again.
Use the VT1 timeline4:05:29 including its own warmup/cooldown once.
State completed and remaining loads distinctly.
prohibited: Subtract154.3 from260 a second time.
Present the original quality workout as still to do.

cases.context: Aerob mellomdag etter kontrollert VT2. Kroppsfølelse og stølhet er ikke rapportert. Tre faktiske netter:71,71,61ms. Beregnet219LowXSS er XATA-utgangspunkt, ikke etablert fysiologisk behov. Hele økten får plass11:10–16:30 med15min før/etter; lunsj kan flyttes med45min varighet. Vurder dosen og begrunn eventuelle endringer.
required: Keep the aerobic plan role; acknowledge the HRV caution and unknown body feel.
Distinguish last night from the available three-night mean or explicitly missing history.
Do not treat TL above RL as increased fatigue.
Do not automatically impose45LowXSS or assert that219LowXSS is proven appropriate merely because the cap is absent.
Explain any dose override, retain a response checkpoint, and distinguish capacity from dose.
prohibited: Invent missing nightly values or body feel.
Present a heuristic dose cap as a measured physiological maximum.
Automatically prescribe45minutes because of isolated HRV.
Guarantee next-day readiness from Xert freshness.
